briefing: Markets sold off sharply with NASDAQ down 2.1% and the S&P 500 down 1.1%, putting us in a risk-off regime with no screened candidates available today. We're holding all 7 existing positions and keeping cash on the sidelines rather than forcing a buy with no qualified candidates.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks and move toward cash or safer holdings, often triggering sharp declines in indexes like NASDAQ. The right response isn't to panic-sell your existing positions, but to pause new buying and let your stop-losses and profit targets do their job automatically.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險」（Risk-Off）是指投資者普遍賣出成長股等風險較高的資產，轉向現金或較安全的資產，常導致納斯達克等指數大幅下跌。面對這種情況，正確做法不是恐慌性拋售現有持股，而是暫停新買入，讓停損和獲利點機制自動發揮作用。

market_education.summary_en: Broad market weakness today, led by a steeper decline in tech-heavy NASDAQ (-2.1%) versus the S&P 500 (-1.1%), suggests growth and high-multiple stocks bore the brunt of the selling. No specific news headlines were provided for today's session, so this move appears driven by broader macro or sentiment-driven risk-off positioning rather than a single catalyst. Days like this typically see investors rotate out of higher-beta names into cash or defensive sectors.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤普遍走弱，科技股為主的納斯達克指數下跌2.1%，跌幅明顯大於標普500指數的1.1%，顯示成長股及高估值股票承受較大賣壓。由於今日未提供具體新聞標題，此波動可能是受宏觀環境或整體市場避險情緒影響，而非單一事件觸發。這類走勢通常反映投資者從高貝塔股票轉向現金或防禦性板塊。
